summary: Inventory Part Remains in Quoted Status after Line Status Changes from Need Approval to Approved
reported_issue: When a line status is changed from Needs Approval/Authorization Required to Approved/Authorized, a requested Inventory Part incorrectly stayed in Quoted status instead of updating to 'In stock' with a Pick action.
expected_after_fix: The inventory part status should automatically update from Quoted to In stock (action Pick) when the line is authorized.
steps_i_followed: Located an existing fixture matching the precondition: WO S9-24011, line a93ad8f1 in status 'authorization_required' with an inventory-source part request (375f3eb3, inventory_part_id 794a9962) sitting in status 'quoted'.
Captured the before state via GET /api/work-orders/lines/{wo}: line=authorization_required, part=quoted / 'Quoted', src=inventory.
Changed the line status to authorized via POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-status {line_id, status:'authorized'} (HTTP 200).
Re-read the line and inspected the same inventory part request; captured the parts tab screenshot.
actual_now: After authorizing the line, the inventory part request automatically transitioned from 'Quoted' to status 'in_stock' (label 'In stock'). It no longer remains in Quoted. This matches the expected 'In stock / Pick' behavior.
notes: Tested on real fixture WO S9-24011 (disposable staging). The part moved to 'In stock' which is the Pick-able state, exactly as expected_after_fix.
